description.short: Detects stock-out risk, convenes owners, recommends transfers. Demo data only.
description.full: Semi-autonomous coworker for UC1 Athletic Marketplace Inventory Rebalancing. It listens for Tier-1 stock-out signals from Fabric Real-Time Intelligence, opens a case chat with the accountable people, explains transfer options with policy citations and writes approved stock transfer orders to the ERP only after a named owner approves. All data is SYNTHETIC.

commands.title: status
commands.description: Show the case status and current recommendation

commands.title: policy
commands.description: Ask a policy question, e.g. transfer cost cap for launch styles

commands.title: data
commands.description: Ask a data question, e.g. weeks of cover for HM9443 by market

commands.title: constraint
commands.description: Add a constraint, e.g. exclude DE as a source, re-simulates
